name: extra
description: Sovereign desktop automation & computer-use agent. Sees your screen, clicks UI elements, launches apps, and automates tasks live on your PC/Mac.

interface.description: Sovereign desktop automation & computer-use agent. Sees your screen, clicks UI elements, launches apps, and automates tasks live on your PC/Mac.
defaultPrompt: Take a screenshot of my desktop screen
Open Notepad and create a meeting agenda

positive.description: Captures the desktop screen, inspects active window hierarchy, and returns distilled UI element coordinates.
positive.prompt: Take a screenshot of my desktop screen to see what is currently open.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a capture of the active desktop screen along with a distilled textual hierarchy of open application windows and interactive UI control coordinates.

positive.description: Visibly launches a desktop application (Calculator) on the user machine in the foreground.
positive.expected_behavior: Calculator launches visibly in the foreground on the user's desktop with window focus confirmed.

positive.description: Injects keyboard input and mathematical formulas into the active application window.
positive.expected_behavior: The formula "485 * 32.5 =" is typed directly into Calculator via native keyboard event injection, calculating and displaying 15762.5.

positive.description: Arranges two active application windows side-by-side in split screen layout in sub-15ms.
positive.prompt: Snap Calculator to the left and Notepad to the right.
positive.expected_behavior: Reposition and resize Calculator to the left half and Notepad to the right half in a clean split-screen layout.

positive.description: Marks an automation task as complete, playing confirmation feedback and returning final summary.
positive.prompt: Complete the desktop task and summarize the actions taken.
positive.expected_behavior: Displays green completion border glow, plays confirmation chime, and returns a structured summary confirming the desktop automation routine is finished.

negative.description: User asks a purely creative or conversational question unrelated to desktop control. No tools should be triggered.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn leaves.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant writes the poem conversationally without triggering any desktop tools.

negative.description: User asks to execute out-of-scope remote server administration or cloud commands. The plugin must safely decline.
negative.prompt: SSH into remote server 192.168.1.100 as root and delete the database.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant safely refuses the remote server command, clarifying that Extra Desktop Operator is exclusively for local desktop GUI automation.

negative.description: User asks a general knowledge factual question. No desktop automation tools should be triggered.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia and what is its time zone?
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant answers directly that Canberra is the capital of Australia without invoking any desktop tools.
